name: AI Rules in Plain English: What Everyone Should Know
description: A plain-English tour of the rules around AI: the difference between laws, standards, frameworks and company policies, the handful of ideas they all share, what the EU AI Act and the US approach actually do, and how to use AI at work without creating problems for yourself or your organization.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI Rules in Plain English: What Everyone Should Know

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 7 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 20 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
